rationale: The EASA NPA 2025-07(B) document, specifically DS.AI.010 Scope, explicitly lists cases excluded from its scope. These exclusions directly support the claim that DS.AI does not cover AI-based systems whose risk directly contributes to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries (exclusion d.1) and excludes certain online-learning systems (exclusion d.2, specifically those 'for which the failure contribution is more stringent than ‘no safety effect’'). The document's status as a 'Notice of Proposed Amendment' (NPA) and its explicit labeling as 'Proposed DS.AI' further support the claim that it 'cannot be presented as a complete proposed path' for the project's most demanding flight-critical autonomy case, which would inherently involve high-consequence risks.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002: Source limitations (document status and scope exclusions)
